reviews.x: I was so in love with this when it was in my hotel room at Biltmore, so I bought a bottle immediately to have at home.  Only problem is that it stripped the color from my color-treated hair - and that’s a pretty big problem…

reviews.t: Not the same product as the small hotel shampoo
reviews.x: I purchased this 10oz bottle of Bigelow Lavendar and Peppermint shampoo because I loved the smell of the small Marriot shampoo bottle. Unfortunately, this does not seem to be the same product. The smell and consistency are different; this bottle smells like dish soap with almost no scent. Disappointing.  The bottle came with what looked like a piece of tape around the top but wasn't properly sealed, which meant leaking shampoo and a messy unpacking.

I don't write reviews but i felt i must for this one.  DO NOT BUY!!!  This is definitely not the stuff they give you in hotels.  There was ZERO scent.  I had read similar reviews but i went against my gut.  Never again.

I ordered this over the summer and it came when I was literally leaving the driveway for a several week vacation. It was an envelop with nothing inside except the scent of the product! Literally, nothing inside

Well considering that amazon had to refund the product for what ever reason I did not order the item again but I have used it and did like it very much..idk what the issue was but pretty disappointing
I guess the formula changed. It now smells like Dial soap. Save yourself the money. So disappointed. This scent has buoyed my spirits through the shutdown.
This is NOT the real C.O. Bigelow!  The texture, smell, and quality is super FAKE! Very Disappointed.

reviews.t: Good, but not what I was hoping for
reviews.x: CO Bigelow used to make a Menthe Shampoo that I absolutely loved. It was really great for cooling my scalp, lifting the roots, and giving me tighter curls. Unfortunately, they no longer make it. My hope was that the Lavender Peppermint would have similar results. It does not. Don't get me wrong, it’s a great shampoo, just not the results I was hoping for.

Bigelow products stood for great quality. Not this product. It is quite diluted and takes a lot of it to use to get clean.  All other man products produced pre-pandemic were great and most are discontinued now. Bigelow get back to basics of simple and good quality products...
I first used this because I tried one of those little hotel bottles.  Then I had to find it online.  It makes my hair feels so soft and luxurious.

reviews.t: Not quite as Aromatic as the Store :-(
reviews.x: The scent is not as aromatic as what you buy in the store or at the hotel.
Terrible scent and watery consistency. I returned the product.

Learned about this C.O. Bigelow Lavender Peppermint Shampoo while on a trip to NYC that a hotel provides in their bathrooms. It has a nice scent and seems to do the job also. Purchased a few bottles and their larger sized soap bars with same scent. On the pricey side but I think the quality is worth it. Very satisfied.

Went to a hotel that had these in trial size and my wife loved them. Did not look at volume before buying so came as a surprise to get a bottle smaller than a soda can for 18 dollars. I will see how long it lasts and may change my review.

For 20 dollars this thing is heavily diluted with water.  Not worth it.  It reminds me of my old broke college years where I had to fill a nearly empty bottle of soap to last longer with water.  Smells great though.

reviews.t: Beware the bottle is broken when open the package
reviews.x: The bottle ship broken too bad packing for shipment the product itself is very good but broken of packing waste me nearly half of it
The bottle shown is only about 4 inch tall , and the Lavender smell is very weak. Not worth the money . Returning.
I love this shampoo.  Leaves your hair so soft and shiny.  Will definitely be purchasing again.

reviews.t: Note quite a good as the small bottles from hotel rooms. But still ok
reviews.x: Not quit the same scent as from hotels where I first discovered it.
Lid is broken. Shampoo leaked. Unable to close bottle.
Amazing smell and makes my hair so soft and alive!

I love the zingy, fragrant scent of the shampoo. It feels relatively unisex, and doesn't leave a lot of fragrance lingering behind after you rinse it out. I followed up with a peppermint conditioner from the natural food store, and really enjoyed the lovely cooling summer pick me up for my hair.  The shampoo is not overly stripping, but definitely leans more towards really getting things clean rather than being overly moisturizing. I found that I could use it about three times a week on my long

reviews.t: Love the subtle scent, the copious foaming, and the squeaky clean results.
reviews.x: I've used Bigelow products before years ago and recall loving them so was anxious to resample a shampoo offering. Love the scent combination with lavender being relaxing and peppermint energizing. The scent is subtle but enjoyable. The shampoo makes an enthusiastic lather of foam. It cuts oil and dirt but seemingly doesn't strip my hair, but leaves it squeaky clean without needing a second application. It's not inexpensive, but I love the scent and the clean results. Recommended.

This shampoo smells great. The scent is very natural, but unfortunately it's not. Rather than using the pricier essential oils of peppermint and lavender, the company uses synthesized fragrance. The lather is decent and washes your hair about as well as any bargain-priced brand from the supermarket shelf. I did notice that it leaves my hair feeling a bit flat. There is no reason for the high price aside from name familiarity, as this brand is used by some hotel chains.

What I like about this product: *It smells fantastic with the perfect blend of peppermint and lavender.  The scent is not overpowering like some peppermint shampoos I've tried; *It lathers really well. *It leaves my hair feeling and looking shiny and clean.  What I don't like about the product: *The bottle is relatively small for the price ($18.00 for 10.14 ounces at the time of this review); *The cap broke off after the first use.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product does not match the scent or quality of the hotel version they loved, describing it as smelling like dish soap or Dial soap, having little to no scent, or being a fake or changed formula.
Several reviewers find the shampoo heavily diluted or watery, requiring a lot to get clean and not worth the price.
Some reviewers praise the scent and say it makes their hair feel soft and luxurious, with quality worth the price.
A few reviewers report problems with color-treated hair being stripped or with receiving an empty package.
Some reviewers note the bottle is smaller than expected for the price.
